scope: First closure-decomposition pass for all directly owned constraints and operations of AcceptActionUsage and TriggerInvocationExpression. It does not close their grammar, inherited metamodel, semantic prose or library dependency obligations.
method: Enumerated both classes in the pinned XMI, read every local operation/constraint expression and accept semantics in SysML 8.4.13.6, then drafted positive/negative boundary partitions. Statuses are bounded evidence observations or code-location candidates, not claims of complete implementation. No second review or new execution is implied.
